subject: OptiBank enterprise access: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlists — onboarding coordination
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@optibank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: optibank-it@optibank.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Enterprise access requirements for Redwood onboarding

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. Per our security team, we want to confirm a few items before kickoff so we can pull the right stakeholders:

- SAML/SP-initiated and IdP-initiated support (we use Okta, versioned metadata attached).
- SCIM: group provisioning only (we will map groups to roles), lazy reprovisioning is preferred. Any recommended attribute mappings?
- IP allowlists: we'll want to restrict the admin console and the SCIM endpoint to a set of static ranges.
- Service account pattern and rotation: do you support customer-managed service accounts with key rotation?
- Org policies: we need to ensure audit events land in our SIEM (Splunk) and that data retention for logs meets our 3-year requirement.

I've attached our SAML metadata and an initial IP list (internal stub). If you can send a short plan (milestones + roles) we can book the kickoff with identity and security.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
IT Project Lead
OptiBank
Attachment: optibank_saml-metadata.xml (application/xml)
Attachment: optibank_ip-list.csv (text/csv)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@optibank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enterprise access requirements for Redwood onboarding

Hi Alice — great questions, and thanks for sending the metadata. Quick responses inline and a proposed kickoff agenda below. See attached checklist for the detailed implementation items.

- SAML: We support both SP- and IdP-initiated flows. We recommend SP-initiated for first-pass verification during canary. We'll consume your Okta metadata (looks good).
- SCIM: We support group provisioning and attribute mapping. Recommended attributes: displayName, mail, title, members. For groups -> roles mapping we suggest a small canonical set to start (admin, engineer, readonly).
- IP allowlists: We can restrict access to the admin console and SCIM push endpoint. We require a primary CIDR + secondary CIDR for failover. Also recommend a VPN egress IP if you want to lock further.
- Service accounts: We support Redwood-managed service accounts and customer-managed (via our KMS/HSM integration). Rotation: we support automated rotation every 90 days and immediate key revocation on demand.
- Audit/logs: We emit audit events for auth, SCIM syncs, and admin actions. We'll provide a Splunk ingestion guide and delivery options (syslog, HTTPS push).

Proposed kickoff agenda (30-45m):
1) Introductions + goals
2) SAML exchange & test IdP configuration
3) SCIM membership mapping & attribute filters
4) IP allowlist and service account plan
5) Rollout plan (canary -> full org) and maintenance window
6) Action items & owner assign

Can Monday 17 May 10–10:45 PT work for you? We'll include Monica (CS lead) to drive milestones and Laura to own the rollout policy.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-enterprise-access-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@optibank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: optibank-it@optibank.com, Jared Lim <jared.lim@optibank.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enterprise access requirements for Redwood onboarding

Hi Neha — Monday works. A few follow-ups so the right people join:

- SCIM group filters: we only want to sync groups with prefix RBW- (Redwood). Can you apply a group filter on your side?
- Attribute mapping: we need employeeNumber passed as an externalId for audit mapping. Is that supported?
- IP allowlists: attaching an updated list. Primary egress: 198.51.100.0/24, secondary: 203.0.113.128/25. Will you accept these as source ranges for SCIM/API?
- Service account naming: our policy requires service accounts be scoped to a project namespace: optibank/redwood/onboarding. We also require proof of key rotation before production.

We'll join Monday with identity, security, and infra.

Best,
Alice
Attachment: optibank_ip-list.csv (updated)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@optibank.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enterprise access requirements for Redwood onboarding

Hi Alice / Neha — thanks for the details. I've sketched a milestone plan and owners below for the kickoff. I've also added a shared folder for artifacts.

Milestones (target dates):
- 2027-05-17: Kickoff + SAML smoke test (IdP metadata loaded) — Owner: Neha
- 2027-05-20: SCIM group-mapping trial (RBW- filter applied) — Owner: OptiBank identity team + Redwood integrations
- 2027-05-24: Canary rollout (5% org, admin console access for test admins) — Owner: Laura
- 2027-05-31: Full rollout after successful canary and audit ingestion — Owner: OptiBank / Redwood CS

Notes / asks:
- Group filter: we can apply RBW- prefix server-side on the SCIM connector; please confirm the exact prefix and any exceptions.
- employeeNumber -> externalId mapping: supported. We'll include attribute mapping in the SCIM config template.
- IP allowlist acceptance: yes, we can allowlisted your ranges for the SCIM endpoint and admin UI. Please confirm if you need ACLs for specific admin users vs org-wide.
- Service account: we'll provide a customer-managed KMS integration checklist. For production we require rotation proof (audit entry + API key ID).
- Maintenance windows: please confirm two 2-hour slots (one weekday overnight, one weekend window) when we can perform the SCIM sync regression and canary cutover.

Kickoff link: https://meet.redwood.ai/s/optibank-onboard-20270517
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRedwoodOpti/onboarding-collab
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/OPTI-2027-041

Looking forward to Monday.

—Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@optibank.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enterprise access requirements for Redwood onboarding

All — quick confirmation after today's backend checks. A few operational items before we proceed to canary on 2027-05-24: 

1) Canary scope: 5% of org, limited to RBW- groups only; console access limited to optibank/onboarding-test-admins service account.
2) SCIM throttling: we'll cap SCIM push to 10 req/s for the trial window to avoid spike alerts. OptiBank to confirm acceptable window.
3) IP allowlist: both ranges accepted (198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/25). We'll apply at the edge and SCIM endpoint.
4) Key rotation: please upload proof (audit log or rotation API response) to the shared folder prior to full rollout.
5) Audit stream: we'll send a Splunk HEC endpoint; OptiBank to confirm token TTL and ingestion retention.

If all good, we'll proceed with the canary on 2027-05-24 03:00–05:00 PT (weekday overnight). Please respond with maintenance window confirmation and provide the rotation proof by 2027-05-27.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Access Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
